Hi all — attaching the requested summary (latency-summary.csv). Notes:
- p50/p95/p99 are included for both 1k and 8k seq. CSV includes median payload size and tokenization assumptions.
- Our 8k runs were done with the quantized variant (q4f16); 95th/99th tail is sensitive to batching and network jitter — we'll show representative curves but can re-run specific shapes if you want a live check.
- If FintechCo can expose a short 3-minute pre-check endpoint (simple POST for a 1k and 8k sample payload) during Tues morning we can run a quick smoke test before the briefing. If not, we can demo using our telemetry and recorded runs.
